Is it possible to share a dashboard with view-only access to someone who doesn't have a Kataja login? We'd like to share a read-only view with external stakeholders without adding seats.

Astrid Salminen

subject: New user seat setup
body: Please set up a new Standard seat for a new team member starting next week. Details attached.

subject: Dashboard sharing within team
body: How do I share a dashboard I built with just my team rather than the whole workspace? Couldn't find the option.

subject: Export recipient limit
body: Is there a cap on how many recipients a scheduled export can have? Want to add our whole reporting distribution list.

subject: Password reset for locked account
body: One of our users is locked out after too many failed login attempts. Can you reset it on your end?

subject: Alert not respecting business hours
body: We set an alert to only notify during business hours but it's firing overnight too. Can you check the schedule setting on the rule?

subject: Bulk seat update
body: We're reorganizing our reporting team and need to update roles for about six users at once. Is there a bulk edit option, or do we need to do this one by one?

subject: Adding a seat for new hire
body:
We have a new team member starting Monday and need to add a seat. Can you confirm the process and whether we'll be billed immediately or at the next renewal?

Sanna Møller

subject: Alert setup for cash flow threshold
body: Could someone help us configure an alert for when our cash flow dashboard crosses a threshold? Want to get the syntax right for a fairly complex condition.

subject: API scope for finance dashboards
body: We're building an internal treasury tool and want to pull specific finance dashboard data via API. What's the recommended scope/permission setup for this on Enterprise?

subject: Feature request: connector for our new ERP
body: We're migrating ERPs next year - is a connector for the new system already supported, or should we submit a request now to get ahead of it?

subject: Feature request: dashboard versioning
body: Would be useful to have version history on dashboards so we can see what changed and roll back if needed, especially for board-facing ones. Worth considering for the roadmap?

subject: Report builder scripting question
body: Is there a way to use custom calculated fields in report builder beyond the standard formula list? Want to build a slightly more complex ratio.

subject: Connector failed before month-end again
body: Connector failed right before month-end close, same as last quarter. Need this fixed today.

subject: Can't add new seat during close week
body: Trying to add a seat for temp help during close and the admin panel won't let me. Terrible timing.

subject: Dashboard blank on top of everything else
body: Now the dashboard's blank too. Three issues in two days. Please just fix the account.

subject: Alert spam - same alert 10 times
body: Getting the same alert notification repeatedly, ten times in an hour. Please stop the loop.

subject: Dashboard loading issue, again
body: Dashboard's slow to load again, similar to what happened in May. At least it usually gets sorted quickly once someone looks at it.

subject: Connector down
body: Connector's down. Need this looked at today, not tomorrow.

subject: Seat permission error
body: Getting a permission error trying to update a colleague's role. Blocking her from doing her job.

subject: Second admin issue same day
body: Now a second admin panel issue today - can't remove a departed employee's seat either. Please check the whole module.

subject: Dashboard numbers wrong
body: Dashboard is showing last week's numbers, not today's. Refresh isn't working.

subject: API also stale
body: API is returning the same stale data as the dashboard. Everything's out of sync today.

subject: Dashboard down before board meeting
body: Dashboard's down two hours before our board meeting. Need this fixed immediately, please call me if easier.

subject: Report builder crashed
body: Report builder crashed mid-edit, lost my changes. Second crash this month.

subject: Alert firing on wrong metric
body: Alert is firing based on the wrong metric entirely - configured for revenue but triggering off headcount. Please check the rule mapping.

subject: Alert delay again
body: Alerts running hours late again today. Same issue as before, though it usually gets picked up fast once flagged.

subject: Dashboard error on refresh
body: Getting an error every time I try to manually refresh a dashboard. Basic function, shouldn't be this flaky.

subject: Alert broken again before year-end
body: Alerts broken again right before year-end reporting. Feels like every close period something breaks.

subject: Export failing same day as alerts
body: Export failing too, same day as the alert issue. At least support usually turns these around quickly - appreciate that much.

subject: Data connector sync failing overnight
body: Our Salesforce connector has stopped syncing since Friday — dashboards are showing data from last week. Can someone look into this today? We rely on the overnight sync for the Monday reporting pack.

subject: Cannot remove departed user from seat count
body: We offboarded two analysts in November and they're still showing as active seats, which means we're being billed for licenses we don't need. I raised this with support last week with no update. Please remove them and confirm the seat count.

subject: Connector sync broken again — same issue as August
body: This is the same overnight sync failure we had back in August, and it's back with no warning. Three days now with stale data in every dashboard. We were told this was fixed — clearly it wasn't.

subject: Exports failing AND connector issue from January still open
body: Now exports are timing out on anything over 5,000 rows, on top of the connector sync problem from three weeks ago that still has no resolution. Two broken modules at once is not acceptable for what we pay. I need an actual timeline, not another ticket number.

subject: Escalating — connector failures for the third time this year
body: I'm escalating this. The connector has now failed three times since August and each time we're told it's fixed. I've looped in our CSM on this thread. We need a permanent fix, not another patch, or we'll need to have a serious conversation about the contract.

subject: Report builder crashing on save — escalating again
body: Report builder is throwing an error every time we try to save a multi-page report, losing all unsaved changes. Given the pattern this year I'm flagging this as urgent and asking for a call, not just a ticket reply.

subject: Re: Exports — thanks, this is finally sorted
body: Appreciate the call yesterday and the fix that followed — exports have been running clean since this morning. Good to actually see this resolved properly for once.

subject: Seat audit — following up from the call
body: Following up on what we discussed — could you send the seat audit you mentioned? Want to make sure we're not paying for anything we don't use, but no complaints, the process this week has been smooth.

subject: Alert threshold question
body: Quick one — can alert thresholds be set per dashboard rather than account-wide? Not urgent, just exploring options now that things are running well again.

subject: Scheduled export template — small tweak needed
body: The new export template is working nicely for the board pack. One small ask: could the file naming include the date automatically? Happy to hop on a call if easier.

subject: Alert digest timing
body: Noticed the daily alert digest is arriving around 9am rather than the 7am we configured — not urgent, just flagging for whenever you have a moment.

subject: New connector request — Xero
body: We'd like to add a Xero connector alongside the existing ones. Let me know what's needed on our end to get that set up.

subject: Report builder — formatting issue in PDF output
body: Table borders are missing when reports are exported to PDF from the builder, though they show fine on screen. Not urgent, wanted to flag before our next board cycle.

subject: Dashboard sharing link expired unexpectedly
body: A shared dashboard link we sent to our auditor stopped working after a week even though we set it to no expiry. Could you check the sharing settings on our end?

subject: Connector setup question — NetSuite
body: Setting up the NetSuite connector for our finance team and running into an auth error during OAuth setup. Can you point us to the right scopes and permissions needed on the NetSuite side?

subject: Alert emails not sending
body: Threshold alerts on the revenue dashboard haven't fired in three days despite conditions clearly being met. This is exactly the kind of thing we need alerts for. Please fix today.

subject: Report builder — template broken after last update
body: Since yesterday's update our quarterly template throws a formatting error on every save. We were mid-report when it broke.

subject: Alerts STILL not firing
body: Two days later and still nothing from the alert engine. This is now affecting three teams who rely on it daily.

subject: Duplicate alert emails now
body: Fix attempt has caused the opposite problem — we're getting the same alert 6 times in a row. Please just make it work once, correctly.

subject: Re: Alerts — one more issue
body: Now the duplicates have stopped but the threshold value reset to default overnight. Third message today on the same feature.

subject: Dashboard widget stuck loading
body: The revenue-by-region widget has been spinning for two days straight on every dashboard it's used on. Nobody can see current numbers.

subject: Connector auth failing after password rotation
body: We rotated our warehouse credentials yesterday per our usual schedule and the connector hasn't reconnected since — no error message, it's just silently stale. Need this fixed before end of day.

subject: Report builder unusable since this morning
body: Can't insert a single chart into any report since this morning's release. Every attempt throws a generic error.

subject: New hire can't get a seat provisioned
body: Tried adding a new analyst seat twice now and it just spins and fails. She's been unable to log in for two days.

subject: Dashboards blank for half the team
body: Half our users are getting a blank white screen where the dashboard should load, the other half are fine. Nothing changed on our side.

subject: Export button doing nothing
body: Clicking export produces no file and no error, just nothing. Third module broken this week.

subject: Connector sync stuck at 0%
body: Sync has been stuck at 0% for six hours on the main warehouse connector. This is the third connector issue since May.

subject: Seat count wrong on invoice
body: Invoice shows two more seats than we actually have provisioned. Please correct before this goes to finance.

subject: Alerts silent again
body: Same pattern as February — alerts have gone quiet for two days with no errors logged. Please check the alert engine, not just our config.

subject: Dashboard export to PDF cutting off columns
body: PDF export from the dashboard view is cutting off the rightmost two columns on every report we run today.

subject: Alert not triggering on budget overrun
body: Configured an alert for budget overrun three weeks ago and it has never once fired, even when we blew past the threshold twice. What's the point of the feature if it doesn't work?

subject: Alerts down again
body: Same alert from January has gone silent again. Second time in a month.

subject: Report builder losing formatting on export
body: Every report we build loses all conditional formatting the moment it's exported. Been like this for a week, nobody flagged a change.

subject: Report builder crashing mid-edit
body: Builder crashes and loses unsaved work every time I try to add a second data table to a report. Happened four times today.

subject: API rate limit hit with normal usage
body: We're hitting the API rate limit doing nothing unusual — same call volume as always. Blocking our nightly refresh.

subject: Seat reassignment not working
body: Trying to reassign a licence from a leaver to a new hire and the system won't release the old seat. Blocking onboarding.

subject: Report builder — chart colors reset every save
body: Custom chart colors reset to default every single time the report is saved. Reported similar issues before, this is getting old.

subject: Export stuck processing
body: Export has been stuck at 'processing' for over an hour on a report that's normally instant.

subject: Exports failing on schedule again
body: Scheduled export didn't run this morning, second time this quarter. We need this reliable, it feeds a client deliverable.

subject: Export missing rows
body: Latest export is missing roughly 200 rows compared to the on-screen view. No filters applied that would explain it.

subject: API auth token expiring early
body: API tokens are expiring well before the documented 90-day window, breaking our integration without warning.

subject: Report builder freezing on large tables
body: Builder freezes completely when a table has more than around 50 rows. Have to force-close and lose changes.

subject: Dashboard totals not matching export totals
body: The summary total on the dashboard doesn't match the total in the corresponding export — off by a noticeable margin. Which number are we supposed to trust?

subject: Dashboard widget missing after refresh
body: A widget we built last week vanished from the dashboard after a routine refresh, no error, just gone.

subject: Alert digest — can it include trend arrows?
body: Loving the new alert digest emails — really useful at a glance. One suggestion: would be great if it showed a trend arrow, up or down versus last period, rather than just the raw number. Not urgent, just an idea for the roadmap.

subject: Report builder — thanks for the quick turnaround
body: The custom footer option you added last week is exactly what we needed for the board reports. One small thing: the page numbers aren't updating correctly when a report spans more than 10 pages — could you take a look?

subject: API access to historical snapshots
body: We'd like to pull historical dashboard snapshots via the API rather than just current data — is that something on the roadmap? Happy to be a design partner if it helps.

subject: Alerts — request for Slack integration
body: Would it be possible to route alerts to a Slack channel instead of just email? Several of the finance team live in Slack and email alerts get lost.

subject: Dashboards — great addition with the new filters
body: The cross-filter feature on the executive dashboard has cut our monthly close reporting time significantly, thank you. Only issue is the filter selection doesn't persist when a user logs back in — could that be remembered per user?

subject: How to set alert recipients per team
body: Trying to figure out how to send different alerts to different teams rather than the whole account. Is that possible, or do we need separate alert rules per team?

subject: API documentation — pagination
body: Can't find documentation on how pagination works for the reports endpoint. Could you point me to it or clarify the parameters?

subject: Data connector — adding a second Postgres source
body: We want to connect a second Postgres database alongside our existing one. Is there a limit on connectors per plan, and what's the setup process?

subject: Connector sync frequency
body: Is it possible to change the sync frequency on the Postgres connector from daily to every 6 hours? Couldn't find the setting.

subject: Export file size limit
body: Got an error exporting a larger dataset — is there a row or file size cap on exports, and is it different by plan tier?

subject: Dashboard — can we set a default view per user role
body: Is there a way to set a default dashboard view depending on the user's role, so analysts and managers land on different screens by default?

subject: Report template missing after account migration
body:
We had several report templates saved from our previous setup, but after the account migration last month they're no longer visible. Were these templates supposed to be carried over? If not, is there any way to recover them?

Erik Halvorsen

subject: Adding an admin user
body: Need to add a second admin on the account so I'm not the only one who can manage seats. What's the process?

subject: Connector fails on large CSV upload
body: The manual CSV connector fails silently on files over roughly 50MB — we've had to split files and check them in Excel first for encoding issues before it'll take them. Is there a documented size limit?

subject: Alert recipients — adding external email
body: Can an alert be sent to an email address outside our domain? Want to loop in an external consultant.

subject: API — rate limit documentation
body: What's the current API rate limit for the Standard plan? Planning a small integration and want to size it correctly.

subject: Dashboard layout resets on mobile
body: When viewing a dashboard on a tablet, the layout reverts to a single-column view even though it's set to a fixed grid on desktop. Is that expected behaviour?

subject: API webhook for new report published
body: Is there a webhook we can subscribe to that fires when a new scheduled report is published? Would save us polling the API.

subject: Dashboard — pinned filters not saving
body: Pinned a filter set on one of our dashboards last week and it's reverted to unfiltered twice since. Not urgent but a bit annoying.

subject: Admin — bulk seat import
body: Onboarding 8 new users this quarter — is there a bulk import option rather than adding seats one by one?

subject: API — bulk export endpoint
body: Following up from the seat import question — is there also a bulk export endpoint, or do we need to loop calls per report?

subject: Connector — timezone on sync timestamps
body: The 'last synced' timestamp on our connectors appears to be in UTC while everything else in the account is CET. Could that be aligned?

subject: Dashboard sharing — view-only external link
body: Can we generate a view-only link for an external auditor without giving them a full seat? Couldn't find the option under sharing.

subject: Report builder — merging cells in table view
body: Is it possible to merge header cells across columns in the report builder table view? Trying to replicate a layout from our old Excel template.

subject: API — authentication method
body: Setting up our first API integration — does Kataja support OAuth2 client credentials, or is it API key only?

subject: API — nested objects in report endpoint
body: The report endpoint response has some deeply nested fields that aren't in the documentation. Could you clarify what 'segmentMeta' contains?

subject: API — 500 errors on bulk calls
body: Getting intermittent 500 errors when calling the reports endpoint in a loop — works fine for single calls. Any known limit on concurrent requests?

subject: API — versioning
body: Is there a versioned API endpoint we should be pinning to, so future changes don't break our integration without warning?

subject: API — sandbox environment
body: Is there a sandbox or staging API environment we could test against before pushing changes to production?

subject: Connector dropping rows on sync
body: Our main connector has been dropping roughly 5% of rows on each sync for the past few days — noticed because our totals don't reconcile with the source system anymore. Can you check the sync logs?

subject: Alerts not respecting business hours setting
body: We configured alerts to only fire during business hours but we're getting pinged at 3am regularly. Second config issue we've had to chase down this month.

subject: Exports corrupted — this is becoming a pattern
body: Today's export opened as a corrupted file in Excel, unreadable. Between this and the connector and alert issues from the last two months, I'm starting to lose confidence that a fix stays fixed.

subject: API integration broken since yesterday's release
body: Our nightly integration job has been failing since your release yesterday with no changelog explaining what changed. Thirteen days to fix the last exports issue was already too long — please don't let this one drag.

subject: Escalating — report builder unusable for two weeks now
body: Report builder has been throwing save errors for two weeks and support has not gotten back to us with a fix or even a workaround. Given the pattern since November — connectors, alerts, exports, API, and now this — I'm asking for this to be escalated to someone who can actually own it. We need a call this week.

subject: Still no resolution on report builder from March — and now dashboards down
body: For the record, the report builder issue from March was never properly closed out — we worked around it manually the whole spring. Now the exec dashboard is showing blank tiles for half our team since this morning. Given the history here this needs to be treated as urgent, not queued.

subject: Re: escalation — seat cleanup while we're at it
body: Thanks for jumping on the dashboard issue so fast yesterday — properly appreciated after the run we've had. While we have your attention, could you also tidy up two ghost seats left over from an old offboarding?

subject: API — thanks, integration stable again
body: Wanted to follow up and say the API integration has been running clean for two weeks straight now, no dropped jobs. Appreciate the fix actually holding this time.

subject: Export template — small enhancement
body: Exports have been solid for a while now. Small ask: could we get a CSV option alongside XLSX on the scheduled export? Would help one of our downstream tools.

subject: Exports — CSV option works great
body: The CSV export option is exactly what we needed, thank you. One follow-up: could the delimiter be configurable? Our downstream tool expects semicolons.

subject: Report builder — question on template sharing
body: Can report templates be shared across workspaces, or does each workspace need its own copy? Just planning ahead for next year's structure.

subject: API — planned deprecation notice question
body: Saw a mention of an upcoming API version change in the changelog — is there a migration guide yet, or should we hold off until closer to the date?

subject: Scheduled export - changing delivery address
body:
I need to update the delivery email address on one of our scheduled exports. The person who originally set it up has left. Is there a way to edit an existing scheduled export's settings, or do I need to recreate it?

Aino Koskinen

subject: API call limit on Standard plan
body:
Can you confirm the API call limit for the Standard plan? I want to make sure we don't exceed it before expanding our integration.

Aino Koskinen

subject: Report builder - saving a view with applied filters
body:
I'd like to save a report with specific filters pre-applied so colleagues open it in the right view by default. Right now they have to re-apply filters each time. Is there a way to save a filtered view?

Aino Koskinen

subject: Connector not syncing - started a few days ago
body:
Our data connector stopped updating on June 17th. No error is showing, it just stopped. Dashboard data is stale. I've tried re-saving the connector config but nothing changed. Please look into this.

Aino Koskinen

subject: Report builder losing custom formulas on refresh
body: Custom formulas in three of our recurring reports get wiped every time the underlying data refreshes, forcing us to rebuild them each week. This is eating hours we don't have before year-end reporting.

subject: Re: formulas wiped — still happening, now worse
body: Following up on the formula issue from last week — it's still happening, and now it's affecting five reports instead of three. We're a week from year-end close and rebuilding formulas manually every refresh isn't sustainable.

subject: Formula issue is back — thought this was fixed in December
body: This is the exact same formula-wipe problem from December, which we understood was resolved. It's now Q1 close and I'm again rebuilding formulas by hand. I need to understand why a 'fixed' issue keeps coming back.

subject: Alerts not firing for budget variance
body: Configured a budget variance alert weeks ago and it has never triggered despite clear breaches in April. Combined with the still-unresolved report builder problem, our reporting reliability has taken a real hit this year.

subject: Escalating — report builder formula issue never actually resolved
body: Coming back to this because it's never gone away — the formula-wipe issue we first raised in December is still happening, on and off, ten months later. I'd like this properly escalated with an engineer who can look at root cause, not another config check.

subject: Escalating — seat provisioning broken for a month
body: We've had a new hire unable to get proper report-builder permissions for almost a month now despite three tickets. Between this and the ongoing formula issue, I'm asking for a call with someone senior on your side this week.

subject: Re: seat provisioning — thanks for the call
body: Appreciate the call and the fix that followed — the new hire is fully provisioned now. Will be watching to make sure it holds.

subject: Formula issue — finally seeing this hold
body: It's been a month since the fix and the formula-wipe issue hasn't recurred once, including through two refresh cycles. Genuinely relieved to see this actually stick this time.

subject: Report builder — small formatting request
body: Since things are stable now — any chance of adding a way to lock column widths in a report so they don't reflow on refresh? Nice to have, not urgent.

subject: Report builder — template library question
body: Is there a shared template library we can build up across the finance team, so people aren't recreating similar reports from scratch each quarter?

subject: Adding a seat for new controller
body: Adding a new financial controller to the team next week — please provision a Professional seat with report-builder access.

subject: Seat role adjustment
body: Could you adjust one of our existing seats from viewer to editor? Role changed internally, needs updated access.

subject: API returning stale cache
body: The reports API is returning data that's clearly a day old even though the dashboard shows current numbers. Is there a cache layer we need to bypass with a header or parameter?

subject: Export missing latest month
body: Monthly export is consistently missing the most recent month's data until several days into the new month. Timing seems off somewhere in the pipeline.

subject: Report builder — formula errors since API fix
body: Since the API cache issue was patched, several report builder formulas that reference API-sourced fields are now throwing errors. Feels like the fix broke something else.

subject: Report builder still broken — third ticket on this
body: Same formula errors as last month, still unresolved. This is the third ticket on report builder in six weeks and it's affecting a report going to our board next week.

subject: Escalating — dashboards down for exec team
body: The executive dashboard set has been down or showing errors intermittently for two days, right as we're heading into board week, on top of the still-unresolved report builder formula issue. I need this escalated and a status update by end of day.

subject: Report builder — escalation, formulas STILL broken
body: Following up on the escalation — dashboards are stable now but the underlying report builder formula issue from January has never actually been fixed, just worked around manually every cycle since. This needs proper root-cause attention.

subject: Dashboards — confirming the fix held
body: Wanted to confirm the dashboard stability fix from the escalation has held through two full board cycles now. Good to have this one closed out.

subject: Alerts — thanks, config change applied cleanly
body: Appreciate the quick turnaround on the alert config change we discussed. Working exactly as expected.

subject: Admin — adding two seats for new analysts
body: Bringing on two new analysts next month, please provision Enterprise seats with dashboard and report builder access.

subject: Report builder — formulas holding steady, one small ask
body: The formula issue really does seem behind us now — several months clean. Small ask: could conditional formatting rules be copied between reports rather than rebuilt each time?

subject: Report builder — template versioning question
body: Is there any version history on report templates? Would be useful to roll back if someone accidentally overwrites a shared template.

subject: Date filter not working as expected in custom report
body: The date filter on my custom report defaults to 'this month' when I open it, even though I saved it with a specific date range. Is there a way to lock the filter so it doesn't reset? It's a small thing but people keep running the report with the wrong period.

subject: Intermittent 401s — key unchanged
body: Sporadic 401 errors, key hasn't changed, works then fails then works again. No time-of-day pattern. Gaps in our pipeline.

subject: Alerts stopped sending emails — still no fix on API issue either
body:
Our alert notifications stopped arriving by email about a week ago. The alerts show as triggered in the platform but nothing lands in the inbox. We've checked spam filters. Nothing.

Also — I raised an API authentication issue on July 1st and it's still unresolved. The intermittent failures are continuing. I'd appreciate some actual progress on both of these.

subject: API auth failures — still seeing them
body: Following up again on the 401 errors from the API. The alerts email issue was fixed, thank you. But the API problem continues. At this point I've logged this three times. If the answer is that we need to re-issue the key or change something on our end, just tell us and we'll do it. We just need it to work consistently.

subject: API rate limit documentation — where to find current limits
body: Where can I find the current API rate limits for our plan tier? We're seeing slower response times lately and want to check if we're close to any limits before investigating further. The documentation page I bookmarked seems outdated.

subject: API pagination not returning complete dataset
body: When fetching large result sets via the API using cursor-based pagination, we're getting duplicate records across pages and some records appear to be missing entirely. We've checked our implementation against the documentation and it looks correct. Reproducible with our events endpoint. Please advise.

subject: Need to transfer admin access to new IT contact
body: Our previous admin contact has moved to a different role. I need to transfer the admin account to myself. Old admin email: jonne.makinen@[company].fi. Please confirm the process. I'm the new IT contact going forward.

subject: PostgreSQL connector sync failing after DB upgrade
body: We upgraded our PostgreSQL instance from 13 to 16 last weekend and the Kataja data connector has been failing to sync since then. Error in the sync log: 'SSL connection required'. Our DB does require SSL but as far as I can tell the connector was working fine with SSL before the upgrade. Has something changed in how the connector handles the SSL handshake? We need this fixed — it's our primary data source.

subject: API response latency — p95 has doubled in the last two weeks
body: We monitor our API response times and the p95 latency has roughly doubled in the past two weeks. We haven't changed our call patterns. Is there something going on infrastructure-side? Still also waiting on the data connector SSL issue — nothing back from support on that yet.

subject: Bulk export failing for datasets over 500k rows
body: Bulk exports are failing with a timeout error for any dataset over approximately 500,000 rows. We export to CSV for our data warehouse pipeline. This used to work fine. The export starts, runs for a few minutes, then returns a generic error. We have no way to get the full dataset out right now and the connector sync is still broken too. Two major data paths are down simultaneously.

subject: Alert emails going to spam / not delivered
body: Alert notification emails are being caught by our spam filter. IT says the sending domain isn't on an allowlist and the DKIM records look suspicious. Can you provide the SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration we should whitelist? We've missed several alerts because of this.

subject: API field naming changed in response — breaking our parser
body: Something changed in the API response format. The field 'created_at' is now 'createdAt' (camelCase). This is breaking our parser. Was this in a changelog somewhere? We didn't get any notice. Going forward, is there a way to receive advance notice of breaking changes? We need at least a deprecation period.

subject: Scheduled export not running — second time this month
body: Our scheduled daily export didn't run again last night. This happened earlier in December too. The job shows 'queued' and never moves to 'running'. We've tried cancelling and re-scheduling. Same result. We need reliable automated exports — this keeps falling over.

subject: Webhook endpoint documentation — is it current?
body: We're looking at using the webhook integration for real-time event triggers. The documentation page shows an endpoint structure that doesn't match what we're seeing in the actual API explorer. Which is correct? Before we build anything on top of this we need to know the documentation is reliable.

subject: Dashboard — adding a comparison period
body: Is it possible to show a comparison against the same period last year directly on the dashboard tile, rather than as a separate chart?

subject: Admin — SSO setup question
body: Looking into enabling SSO for the account — what identity providers are currently supported?

subject: Export — scheduling to a shared drive
body: Can scheduled exports be delivered directly to a shared drive or SFTP location instead of email attachments?

subject: Export — recipient list management
body: Is there a way to manage the recipient list for a scheduled export in bulk, rather than adding people one at a time?

subject: Alerts — cooldown period between triggers
body: Can we set a cooldown period so an alert doesn't fire again for the same condition within, say, 24 hours? Getting a bit of repeat noise.

subject: Data connector — read replica support
body: Does the Postgres connector support pointing at a read replica rather than the primary, for load reasons on our end?

subject: Report builder — conditional visibility on sections
body: Can a report section be hidden conditionally based on a filter value, similar to conditional formatting on cells?

subject: Admin — audit log export
body: Is there a way to export the admin audit log for our internal compliance review, or is it view-only in the portal?

subject: Data connector — adding a second warehouse region
body: We're adding a second data warehouse hosted in a different region — any latency considerations we should know about before connecting it?

subject: Removing a departed contractor's access
body: A contractor's engagement ended this week — please remove their seat and confirm they no longer have access.

subject: Year-end seat review
body: Doing our year-end review — could you send a current list of active seats and their roles so we can confirm everything matches our records?

subject: API — export endpoint for month-end automation

body:
Hello,

I need to escalate. The report builder is currently not fit for purpose for our finance team. We are dealing with: (1) the sorting issue from January which apparently was not fully fixed, (2) a new issue where adding a second data source to a report causes the first to drop, and (3) formula fields randomly losing their definitions overnight.

We have a board reporting deadline in 10 days and I cannot produce the outputs we need. I would like a call with someone technical this week, not a ticket that sits for six days.

Erik Nieminen
VP Finance

subject: Export to PDF blank — third time this week
body:
Export came out blank again. Third time this week. The report renders fine on screen. Please just fix it.

Erik Nieminen
VP Finance

subject: Export scheduler — confirm correct timezone handling
body:
Hi,

A quick question on the export scheduler. We are in EEST (UTC+3) but the scheduler appears to be running jobs in UTC. Can you confirm whether scheduled exports use the account timezone or UTC, and whether there is a setting to change this?

Erik Nieminen
VP Finance

subject: BigQuery connector — incremental sync not working
body:
Hello,

Our BigQuery connector is set to incremental sync but appears to be doing a full reload every time. This is causing sync times of over 40 minutes. We have a moderately large table (~80M rows) and a full reload every cycle is not viable. Please check the incremental sync configuration.

Erik Nieminen
VP Finance

subject: Dashboard shared link not loading for external users
body:
Hi,

We share dashboards externally via the public link feature. Since approximately 10 July, recipients are getting a loading spinner that never resolves. Internal users see the dashboard fine. Please investigate.

Erik Nieminen
VP Finance

subject: API key rotation broke our integration — no advance notice
body:
Hello,

Our API integration stopped working yesterday. After investigating we found that the API keys for our account were rotated. We received no advance notification of this. The integration is used for automated financial reporting and its failure caused missed outputs.

I would like to understand why keys were rotated without notice, what the standard policy is, and how we can prevent this happening again. I would also like a written response, not just a portal update.

Erik Nieminen
VP Finance

subject: Question on seat reallocation
body: We're restructuring a couple of teams - is there a way to reassign a seat's permission group without losing that user's saved reports?

subject: Report builder - nice addition, small bug
body: Really like the new drag-and-drop layout in report builder. Small bug though, resizing a chart element sometimes overlaps the table below it.

subject: Feature request: bulk role changes
body: Would be great to change permission groups for multiple users at once rather than one at a time - we do this a few times a year during reorgs.

subject: Feature request: conditional formatting rules
body: Any plans to support conditional formatting based on a second column's value in report builder? Currently only seems to support the same column.

subject: Dashboard drill-down not working as expected
body: Clicking through a chart to drill into the underlying data takes you to the wrong date range. Minor, but noticed it a couple of times now.

subject: Alert digest formatting suggestion
body: The daily alert digest email is great - would be even better with the metric name in the subject line rather than just 'Alert Summary'.

subject: Export file encoding issue — special characters corrupted
body:
Hi,

Exports to CSV are producing garbled output for Finnish and Swedish characters (ä, ö, å). The encoding appears to be wrong — looks like Latin-1 rather than UTF-8. We import these files into another system and the corruption causes failures downstream. Can you confirm the export encoding and whether it can be changed?

Juha Bergström
Senior Analyst

subject: Alert not firing on schedule — daily digest missing
body:
Hello,

Our daily digest alert (configured for 08:00 Monday-Friday) has not sent for three days. The alert shows as active and the underlying data is refreshing correctly. Could you check whether there is a delivery issue on the notification side?

Juha Bergström
Senior Analyst

subject: Grouping by week giving unexpected week boundaries
body:
Hi,

When I group a date field by week in the report builder, the weeks seem to start on Sunday rather than Monday. We follow ISO week numbering (Monday start). Is there a setting to change this?

Juha Bergström
Senior Analyst

subject: Report refresh not picking up new data source columns
body:
Hello,

We added new columns to the underlying data source and refreshed the schema in Kataja, but the report builder is not showing the new columns as available to add. Old columns are fine. Do we need to do something additional to make new columns available?

Juha Bergström
Senior Analyst

subject: API returning 500 on /reports/run — no useful error message
body:
Hi,

The /reports/run API endpoint is returning a 500 error for one of our report IDs. The error body just says "internal error" with no further detail. The report runs fine through the UI. We use this endpoint in an automated pipeline so the failure is blocking us. Can you check what is happening on the backend for report ID [REDACTED] and give us a more informative error or a fix?

This is now the fifth issue we have needed to raise in two months. The platform has been less stable than we expected.

Juha Bergström
Senior Analyst

subject: Conditional formatting not saving
body:
Conditional formatting rules are not persisting. I set them, save the report, and when I reopen them they are gone. Happened three times now. Please fix.

Juha Bergström
Senior Analyst

subject: User access audit log — where to find it
body:
Hi,

We need to produce an access audit log for a compliance review — specifically who has logged in and accessed which reports in the past 90 days. Is there an admin panel for this or do I need to request it from you?

Juha Bergström
Senior Analyst

subject: MySQL connector — sync failing with authentication error
body:
Hello,

Our MySQL connector has been failing to sync since yesterday with an authentication error. The credentials have not changed. We have had the encoding problem, the API 500, the alert issue, the conditional formatting bug — and now this. I am starting to keep a list. Can someone look at this as a priority?

Juha Bergström
Senior Analyst

subject: API rate limits dropped without notice — breaking production
body:
API rate limits appear to have been reduced. Our integration was working fine yesterday; today it is hitting limits in the first minute of operation. Nothing changed on our side. The MySQL connector issue from last week is still open. This is unacceptable.

Juha Bergström
Senior Analyst

subject: Report builder — data not matching source on specific date ranges
body:
Hello,

One of our key reports is showing figures that do not match the source data when filtered to certain date ranges (specifically anything crossing a month boundary). The discrepancy is consistent and reproducible. I have checked the data source directly and the source figures are correct. This is a data accuracy issue which is quite serious for us.

We have now had ten support tickets since June. I want to escalate the overall pattern, not just this individual issue. Can someone senior review our account?

Juha Bergström
Senior Analyst

subject: Bulk export job stuck in queue
body:
Bulk export job submitted yesterday morning is still showing as "queued." Other exports are completing. Is there a stuck job on the processing queue?

Juha Bergström
Senior Analyst

subject: Report builder — formula editor freezing on complex expressions
body:
The formula editor in the report builder freezes when I type expressions longer than about 200 characters. I have to save in pieces and refresh constantly. This has been the case since at least August. Is this going to be fixed?

Juha Bergström
Senior Analyst

subject: Dashboard widget arrangement resetting after publish
body:
Hello,

I am writing to report that dashboard widget arrangements are reverting to a previous layout after each publish action. Specifically, the process is: I arrange widgets, save the draft, publish — and the published version shows an older arrangement, not the current one. The draft view shows the correct layout.

I have reproduced this on three separate dashboards over the past week. My current workaround is to republish twice in succession, which sometimes — though not always — produces the correct result on the second attempt.

I recognise this follows a period of several open or recently closed tickets and I am recording the issue here for completeness. We will manage in the meantime.

Juha Bergström
Senior Analyst

subject: Confirm API versioning policy — v1 deprecation timeline
body:
Hello,

Can you confirm the deprecation timeline for API v1? We noticed a warning in the changelog about v1 being deprecated but could not find a specific date. We have integrations on v1 and need to plan the migration. Is there documentation on what has changed between v1 and v2?

Juha Bergström
Senior Analyst

subject: Connector permissions question
body: Setting up a new data connector for our subsidiary and unsure which scopes are needed for read-only reporting access. Guidance appreciated.

subject: API pagination behaving oddly
body: The reports list endpoint seems to skip a page of results intermittently when paginating quickly. Hard to reproduce consistently.

subject: Report builder template not appearing for new users
body: A shared report template isn't showing up in the library for two new starters, though it's visible for the rest of the team.

subject: Connector sync frequency question
body: Can we increase the sync frequency on the ERP connector from hourly to every 15 minutes, or is that plan-dependent?

subject: API response time slower than usual
body: Noticed API response times have roughly doubled over the past week for the dashboard data endpoint. Nothing changed on our integration.

subject: New subsidiary connector setup
body: Following up from earlier in the year, we're now ready to connect the second subsidiary's ERP instance. Same setup as before, just a new source system.

subject: API credentials not working after reset
body: Reset our API key yesterday and the new one is returning 401 errors on every call. Old key was revoked as expected though.

subject: Connector setup for expense system
body: Trying to connect our expense management tool and the connector list doesn't show it as an option, is this one we'd need custom setup for?

subject: Dashboard export button greyed out
body: The export-to-PDF button on our finance dashboard is greyed out for me but works for a colleague with the same role.

subject: Alert threshold seems to have reset
body: Our overspend alert threshold has gone back to a default value we didn't set. Not sure if this was a platform update or something on our side.

subject: API quick question on date format
body: What date format does the API expect for the from/to parameters on the reports endpoint? Getting inconsistent results.

subject: Connector for expense system now available?
body: Saw in the changelog that a new connector went live - is this the expense tool we asked about last year? Keen to set it up if so.

subject: API sync failing overnight
body: Overnight API sync to our reporting layer failed last night with no rows written. Team's already grumbling about just pulling the numbers into Excel manually if this keeps happening, would rather not go back to that.

subject: Export stuck in queue for over a week
body: Our scheduled export has been stuck in 'processing' for eight days now. A colleague who previously used Dashlume mentioned their export queue never had this problem, hoping this gets sorted quickly, this is dragging on.

subject: Connector auth expired without warning
body: The connector to our accounting system lost authentication with no notification email, so we only noticed when the numbers stopped updating. Would help to get an alert when this happens.

subject: Report builder chart type missing
body: Trying to build a stacked bar chart in report builder but only see the regular bar option. Is stacked available on our plan?

subject: Adding a new user
body: Please add one new user under our Standard plan seats, same access as our existing analyst.

subject: Dashboard looking great, small tweak needed
body: The new dashboard layout has gone down really well with the team. One tile is cut off on smaller screens though, could that be adjusted?

subject: API - question on batch endpoint
body: Is there a batch endpoint for pulling multiple reports in one call? Would simplify our nightly job nicely if so.

subject: Reorganising our team structure in admin
body: We're restructuring into three sub-teams and want to mirror that in admin groups. Happy to hop on a call if that's easier than back-and-forth tickets, no rush on our end.

subject: Feature request: connector health dashboard
body: Would love a single view showing sync status across all our connectors rather than checking each one individually. Not urgent, just came up in a team retro.

subject: Feature request: export directly to Google Sheets
body: A few of us still copy exports into Sheets by hand, a direct export destination would save real time. Throwing it out there.

subject: Following up on connector health idea
body: Saw the connector status indicators landed in the last release, nice, thank you. One more idea: could failures also show a suggested fix, not just a red dot?

subject: Export scheduling working well
body: Just a note that the export scheduler has been rock solid the last few months. Minor question, can the completion notification go to a shared inbox instead of just the creator?

subject: Alert rule cloning not copying all fields
body: Cloning an existing alert rule doesn't carry over the recipient list, have to re-add it each time. Small annoyance, team's still very happy overall.

subject: Year-end seat true-up
body: Ahead of renewal, could someone confirm our current seat count against what we're billed for? Just tidying up before year-end.

subject: API rate limit clarification for nightly batch job
body: We're building a nightly batch job that pulls report data via the API and want to confirm the rate limit for our Professional plan before we finalise the retry logic - the docs say 60 requests/minute but we're seeing 429s closer to 40. Could you confirm the actual limit and whether it's per API key or per account? Also happy to share our request pattern if that helps debug.

subject: API timeouts on /reports/export endpoint
body: We're seeing intermittent timeouts on the /reports/export endpoint since early February, roughly one in fifteen calls, logged at our end with request IDs (happy to send the full list). It's forcing us to build retry logic around a call that used to be reliable. We've started benchmarking Storsund BI's API as part of a general vendor comparison this quarter, and consistency under load is one of the things we're testing for, so it'd help to understand what changed here.

subject: Export endpoint timeouts - back again
body: Following up on the timeout issue from February - the rate limit increase you applied helped for a couple of weeks but we're back to seeing the same 429s and occasional 504s on /reports/export, about one in twelve calls this time. We've added exponential backoff and a local cache on our side so the pipeline keeps running, so this isn't blocking us day to day. Logging it again mainly so it's on record - we're still mid-way through the Storsund BI benchmarking and this is one of the data points we're tracking.

subject: Cloning a report template across folders
body: Is there a way to clone an existing report template into a different folder while keeping its filters and layout intact? I tried duplicating from the report list but it lost the saved filter set. Would be useful for setting up next quarter's regional variants without rebuilding each one from scratch. Let me know if I'm missing an option in the UI.

subject: API pagination returning duplicate rows
body: We've noticed the /data/query endpoint occasionally returns the same row twice across paginated calls when a report is large, which is throwing off our downstream row counts. It's happened three times this month that we've caught, all on the weekly sales report. We're de-duplicating on our side for now as a stopgap, but it'd be good to understand whether this is a known pagination edge case or something specific to our setup.

subject: Scheduled export file naming inconsistent
body: Our scheduled exports have started producing files with inconsistent naming - some carry the report date, others just a timestamp, from the same schedule. It's a minor thing but it breaks the folder sorting our finance team relies on downstream. Half the team has drifted back to Excel for the affected reports in the meantime since it's easier to just rename things manually there. Would be good to get the naming convention consistent again when you have a moment.

subject: Pagination duplicates - still happening
body: Coming back to the duplicate row issue from April - our de-duplication step is still catching roughly the same number of repeats each week, so whatever's underneath wasn't fixed, just worked around on our end. It's not causing us problems day to day since the stopgap holds, so no need to prioritise this urgently. More of the team has moved reporting into Excel since spring, partly for reasons like this, so the API traffic on our side has dropped anyway.

subject: Report builder learning curve - some pointers?
body: Team's still getting used to report builder. Ran into an issue where a formatted number field turns to plain text on export, took a while to nail down but appreciate the patience working through it with us.

subject: Export template question
body: Is there a way to save a custom export template so we don't reconfigure the layout every month?

subject: Question on plan seat limits
body: Trying to understand how many seats come with our Standard plan versus how many we're currently using, the numbers in admin don't quite match what we remember signing up for.

subject: Feature request: scheduled export templates
body: Following on from the export template question, would be great if a saved template could also be attached to a schedule directly.

subject: Feature request: simple API for non-developers
body: We're a small team without a developer, any chance of a simplified API mode or Zapier-style connector for basic data pulls?

subject: Report builder - template library suggestion
body: Would be useful to browse a library of pre-built report templates by industry, given we don't have much in-house reporting expertise.

subject: Report builder - thank you for the templates
body: The new template library has honestly transformed how quickly we build reports now. One small thing, the 'Operations' category template has a broken date filter, otherwise excellent.

subject: Connector question ahead of renewal
body: Looking at adding a second data source connector before renewal, can you confirm which connectors are included at Standard versus needing an upgrade?

subject: Dashboard drill-through request
body: Would it be possible to add drill-through from the executive summary dashboard straight into the underlying report? Board found the current two-step process a bit clunky.

subject: Complex alert logic - multi-condition rules
body: We'd like an alert that triggers only when two metrics cross their thresholds together, not either alone. Understand this took longer to scope given how specific it is, but really pleased with how it turned out.

subject: Feature request: API support for the new multi-condition alerts
body: Now that we have the combined alert rules working in the UI, could these also be configurable via the API? We manage most of our configuration as code.

subject: Feature request: alert snooze option
body: Would be handy to snooze an alert for a set period during planned maintenance windows rather than disabling it entirely.

subject: API - quick clarification on rate limits
body: Just confirming our Enterprise rate limit before we scale up a new integration next quarter. Support's been excellent all year, wanted to say so.

subject: Connector missing recent data
body: Our CRM connector hasn't pulled anything new since last week's sync, though the connection shows as active.

subject: Alert not sending to new recipient
body: Added a colleague to an alert list last week and they still haven't received any notifications, even though a threshold was clearly crossed.

subject: Connector re-authentication needed monthly
body: Our CRM connector seems to need re-authenticating every few weeks, is that expected or is there a way to make the connection more persistent?

subject: Currency formatting in report builder
body: We're building a multi-currency expense report and can't find a way to set a different currency symbol per column - it's applying the account default (EUR) throughout even where the underlying figures are in SEK or NOK. Is there a per-column override, or do we need to format this manually after export? Would appreciate a pointer if there's a setting we've missed.

subject: Report builder crashing on large templates
body: The quarterly board report template (around 40 tables) has crashed the report builder twice this week when saving, with no error message, just a blank screen and a lost session. We've started saving more frequently and keeping a local backup of the layout as a precaution. As part of our January tooling review we looked briefly at Storsund BI, though nothing's decided - would help to understand what's causing the crash regardless.

subject: Alert thresholds not triggering reliably
body: We've had at least two instances this month where a budget-variance alert should have fired (threshold crossed on the 3rd and again on the 9th) but no notification arrived, and we only caught it because someone happened to check the dashboard. We've since added a manual weekly check as a backstop, so it's not urgent from our side, but given the pattern we'd like to understand what's causing alerts to go quiet rather than just re-confirming the same settings again.

subject: Report builder formula error
body: A SUMIF-style formula in one of our reports is returning an error on some rows but not others, with no obvious pattern in the data.

subject: Transferring ownership of shared reports
body: A team member who owns several shared reports is leaving, how do we transfer ownership before deactivating their account?

subject: API timeout on large report pull
body: Pulling a report with a full year of data via the API times out after about 30 seconds. Smaller date ranges work fine.

subject: Dashboard tile broken after update
body: A revenue tile on our main dashboard has shown a blank chart since the last platform update. Someone on the team mentioned Storsund BI as an alternative during a demo we sat in on last month, so it would be good to get this looking solid again.

subject: Report builder - can't delete an old draft
body: There's a draft report we no longer need that won't delete, get a generic error every time.

subject: Alert delay of several hours
body: Our stock-out alert fired about six hours after the threshold was actually crossed. Someone mentioned Dashlume claims near-real-time alerting, so curious what the expected delay is meant to be here.

subject: API - field missing from response
body: The 'region' field that used to appear in the report metadata response seems to have disappeared as of this week.

subject: Alert list not respecting time zone
body: Alerts configured for 9am local are arriving at what looks like 9am UTC for a couple of recipients in our team.

subject: Connector year-end date range
body: Want to confirm the accounting connector will correctly split transactions across the fiscal year boundary before we run our year-end reports.

subject: Custom alert rule request
body: Trying to build an alert that combines two conditions with an OR rather than AND, took a bit of back and forth to get the logic right but got there in the end, thanks.

subject: Dashboard tile ordering not saving
body: Rearranged our IT operations dashboard tiles and the new order reverts after a refresh.

subject: Dashboard performance on mobile
body: Dashboards are noticeably slower to load on the mobile app than on desktop. Not a blocker, just noticed it's gotten more sluggish recently.

subject: Feature request: alert escalation chain
body: Would be great if an unacknowledged alert could escalate to a second recipient after a set time, useful for our on-call rotation.

subject: Feature request: webhook signature verification
body: For security, could outgoing webhooks include a signature header we can verify? Our security team flagged this as a gap.

subject: Feature request: connector-level access logs
body: Would help our audits to see a log of exactly what data each connector pulled and when, rather than just sync status.

subject: Report builder - great addition, one bug
body: The new IT asset report template is exactly what we needed. One bug: the 'last patched' column shows blank for assets added this month.

subject: Connector quick fix, fast turnaround
body: Minor auth hiccup on the ServiceNow connector this morning, resolved almost before I finished writing the ticket. Appreciated.

subject: Alert acknowledgement not syncing to mobile
body: Acknowledging an alert on desktop doesn't clear it on the mobile app, so we get double notifications. Quick one hopefully.

subject: API - new endpoint documentation
body: Noticed a new endpoint in the changelog but no docs page yet, could someone point me to a spec or example payload?

subject: How to deactivate a user seat
body: Hello, we have a staff member who has left the company and I need to deactivate their account and free up their seat for a new hire. Could you walk me through the process or point me to the relevant documentation? Thank you, Sigrid Jokinen, VP Finance

subject: API authentication token expiry
body: Hi, we've noticed our API tokens seem to expire without warning, which is causing our scheduled integration jobs to fail overnight. What is the token expiry period and is there a way to set up automatic renewal or longer-lived tokens? Sigrid Jokinen

subject: Salesforce connector failing since last week
body: Hello, our Salesforce connector has been failing since around 14 August. The error in the sync log just says 'authentication failure' but our Salesforce credentials haven't changed. I've already re-entered the credentials twice and the issue persists. This is affecting the data on three of our dashboards. Could someone look into this urgently? Sigrid Jokinen, VP Finance

subject: RE: Salesforce connector failing since last week
body: Following up on our open ticket from 20 August. The Salesforce connector is still not syncing. We're now two and a half weeks without current data in the dashboards our finance team depends on. I've tried everything suggested in your documentation. Please escalate if needed — we need this resolved. Sigrid Jokinen

subject: Dashboard loading extremely slowly
body: Our main finance dashboard has been taking 30–45 seconds to load since the new year. It was fine before. Nothing has changed on our end. This is not workable for daily use.

subject: Connector sync failures — again
body: Connector down again. This is the third time this year. No error details, just 'sync failed'. We have submitted tickets each time and the fixes don't hold. Need a permanent solution, not another workaround. Sigrid Jokinen

subject: Dashboard no longer loads for one user
body: One of our users cannot load any dashboards — the screen just shows a spinner indefinitely. Other users on the same account are fine. I've asked them to clear the browser cache and try a different browser but the issue remains. Please advise. Sigrid Jokinen

subject: Dashboard access for external auditor
body: We need to give a time-limited, read-only dashboard link to an external auditor. Is there a way to do this without creating a full user account?

subject: Alert configured on wrong metric
body: One of our alerts appears to be monitoring gross revenue instead of net, despite being configured for net. Could be a display issue rather than the underlying calculation.

subject: Export access for new auditor
body: Following on from the access question at year-end, this year's auditor also needs export capability, not just view access. Can we set this up the same way as before?

subject: Adding a rolling 12-month view to finance dashboard
body: We'd like to add a rolling 12-month trend view to our main finance dashboard alongside the current fixed calendar-year one, so we can see performance without waiting for January resets each year. Is this something we can configure ourselves in the dashboard builder, or does it need a custom widget on your side? Happy to share the specific metrics if that helps scope it.

subject: API authentication token expiring early
body: Our integration's API token has started expiring after roughly six hours instead of the 24 documented, which means our overnight jobs fail partway through and someone has to manually re-authenticate each morning before the numbers are ready. This has happened four mornings out of the last ten. Could you check whether something changed on the token issuance side recently?

subject: Alerts module - notifications arriving hours late
body: Since May, our budget alerts have been arriving three to four hours after the threshold was actually crossed rather than close to real time, which defeats the point of having them at all for same-day decisions. We've flagged this internally twice now. A couple of the team have gone back to checking figures manually in Excel each afternoon rather than relying on the alerts, which isn't really where we want to be given what we pay for this module. Could this get proper attention rather than a quick patch?

subject: Exported files opening with formatting stripped
body: Scheduled exports to Excel have started losing all number formatting - currency symbols, decimal places, everything reverts to plain numbers on open, since around the start of July. It means every recipient has to reformat manually before the file's usable. Given the alerts issue from a few weeks back, it's been a bit of a run of small things lately. We can live with reformatting manually for now, but wanted to flag it while it's fresh.

subject: Alerts still delayed - following up from June
body: Following up on the alert timing issue from June - notifications are still arriving two to three hours late most days, so the fix doesn't seem to have held. We've settled into manually checking the figures in Excel each afternoon as our real safety net at this point, so there's no immediate pressure to resolve this quickly. Wanted to keep it on record in case it's useful context for whatever's happening underneath.

subject: Report template not saving
body: Hi, I created a report template and saved it, but it's not appearing in the templates list for other users on our account. It shows in my own view. Is there a sharing step I'm missing, or is this a bug? Maria Heikkinen, VP Finance

subject: HubSpot connector not syncing
body: Hello, our HubSpot connector stopped syncing two days ago. The status shows 'connected' but the last successful sync was 23 November. We haven't changed any HubSpot permissions. Could you investigate? Maria Heikkinen

subject: Alert condition builder — AND logic not working
body: Hi, I'm trying to set up an alert that fires only when two conditions are both true (metric A above threshold AND metric B below threshold). When I add both conditions the alert seems to fire on either condition being met individually, not both together. Is the AND logic functioning correctly? Maria Heikkinen

subject: API response time degraded
body: Hello, we've noticed that API response times have increased significantly since the start of the year. Calls that were completing in under a second are now taking 3–5 seconds. We haven't changed our query structure. Is there known degradation on the platform, or could this be related to our account configuration? Maria Heikkinen, VP Finance

subject: Export formatting broken in Excel output
body: The Excel exports we download are coming out with columns merged incorrectly and date fields formatted as plain text rather than dates. This is making post-processing the files much more work than it should be. Also still waiting on a response to ticket #2 from November regarding the HubSpot connector. Maria Heikkinen

subject: API calls dropping intermittently
body: Hello, we're seeing intermittent dropped API calls — requests go out, no error is returned, but no data comes back either. It's happening roughly 10–15% of the time and we can't identify a pattern. We've had to add retry logic to our integration as a workaround but this isn't sustainable. The issue was flagged to your team in January as well. Maria Heikkinen, VP Finance

subject: API still unreliable — following up
body: Still seeing dropped API calls after the fix applied last week. The rate has reduced but not stopped. We need this fully resolved, not partially. This has been ongoing since January. Maria Heikkinen

subject: User permissions resetting on login
body: Hello, we've had two users report that their custom permission settings are reverting to defaults each time they log in. We set the permissions at the admin level and they save correctly, but by the next session they're back to default. This is causing access issues. Could you look into it? Maria Heikkinen

subject: Three connectors failed simultaneously
body: All three of our active connectors failed at the same time this morning. This cannot be a coincidence and suggests a platform-level issue. We've had repeated connector problems since November. This needs to be looked at properly, not just restarted. Maria Heikkinen

subject: Dashboard widgets showing stale data
body: Dashboard is showing data from yesterday even though the connectors show last sync as this morning. Refresh doesn't help. Fix this please — we've had too many data reliability issues this year. Maria Heikkinen

subject: Report builder crashing on large datasets
body: Report builder crashes the browser tab when I try to preview a report with more than about 5,000 rows. This dataset isn't large by any normal standard. No error message, just a blank tab. Completely unusable for our monthly reports. Maria Heikkinen

subject: Alerts not firing at all
body: None of our alerts have fired since 9 May. Zero notifications. Conditions are definitely being met. This has happened before and it takes too long to get fixed. We're having to check the dashboards manually every day. Maria Heikkinen

subject: Dashboard filter options disappeared
body: Hello, the filter panel on two of our dashboards is no longer showing any options — it's just empty. The filters were working last week. I've checked the configuration and nothing appears to have changed. Could you take a look? We'll work from exports in the meantime. Maria Heikkinen, VP Finance

subject: Alert delivery delay — over 4 hours
body: Hello, when alerts do fire now they're arriving 3–5 hours after the condition is met. For time-sensitive thresholds this makes the alerts effectively useless. We've been through enough of these issues that I'm not going to say we expect an immediate fix — but I would like to understand whether there's a structural reason for this and what the realistic timeline for resolution is.
